ArtifactRef.description:
A file of the release: its path relative to the release root and the SHA-256 digest of its bytes, so a consumer fetching files one at a time can verify each.

The digest algorithm is the property name, so a stronger digest can be added later as another property beside sha256 without changing this one.

path.description: Path of the file relative to the release root, in POSIX form.

sha256.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of the file's bytes.

description:
The index of a release of the threat model files.

Serialized to manifest.json at the root of the release. manifest.json and the human-readable README beside it are the fixed root files; consumers read only the manifest and follow its file references, each carrying the file's path and SHA-256 digest, rather than hardcoding directory names.

version.description: Semantic version of this release of the threat models.

schema.description: The JSON Schema this manifest validates against.

catalogs.description: The reference catalogs, each with its data, schema, and report files.

serviceSchema.description: The JSON Schema every service threat model JSON validates against.

services.description: The service threat models in this release, sorted by namespace.
